items.title: Section: "Guest Phenomena" and "Guest Notions" — Neither the Name Nor the Thing It Names Is Truly the Eye

items.zh: 唯當如是如實了知，但於客法有客想轉。汝善男子！若於爾時，於自己名唯有客想已生已得；復應在內如理思惟，於汝眼中所有制立眼名、眼想、眼假施設。如是思惟：我此眼中唯二可得，謂此制立眼名、眼想、眼假施設；及此唯事，於中假立名想施設；除此無有若過若增。於此眼中所有制立眼名、眼想、眼假施設，且非是眼。此唯有事，於中假立眼名想等，當知自性亦非是眼。
items.en:
One should definitively, truly know that there is only the activity of guest notions upon guest phenomena.
Second, regarding the eye and so forth; first, taking up the eye; first, stating what should be reflected upon. "Good son! Once you have generated and grasped this — that regarding your own name there is only a guest notion — you should further reflect properly, inwardly, upon whatever name, notion, and provisional designation has been established for your eye."
Second, explaining the manner of this reflection; first, stating that only name and referent [are found]. Reflect thus: "In this eye, only two things can be found — the established name, notion, and provisional designation 'eye'; and the bare underlying event upon which this name, notion, and designation are provisionally established — beyond these, there is nothing further, neither excessive nor additional."
Second, explaining the absence of true nature; first, stating that neither is [the true eye]. "The established name, notion, and provisional designation 'eye' found in this eye is not itself the eye. This underlying event alone, upon which the name 'eye' and so forth are provisionally established — know that its own nature, too, is not the eye."

items.title: Section: Why Recognition Always Waits on a Name First — And the Same Emptiness Extends to Every Sense and Every Phenomenon

items.zh: 何以故？非於此中遠離所立眼名、眼想、眼假施設，少有眼覺而能轉故。若有此事，體是真實，稱名所說，不應於中更待眼名，方有如是眼覺而轉。唯應自性不由聽聞，不由分別彼所立名，但於此事有眼覺轉。然無如是不待名言，覺轉可得。是故此中，唯於客法而有其客眼名、眼想、眼假施設。汝既如是於其內眼如理思惟，復於眼想唯有客想當生當得。如於其眼，如是於耳鼻舌身等，廣說乃至見聞覺知，已得已求，若已作意隨尋隨伺。以要言之，普於一切諸法想中，唯有客想當生當得。
items.en:
Second, explaining why; first, because apart from the name there is no recognition. Why is this? Because apart from the established name, notion, and designation "eye," not the slightest recognition of an eye could ever arise.
Second, because recognition necessarily waits upon a name. If this underlying event genuinely possessed a true nature corresponding to the name, recognition ought not need to wait upon the name "eye" in order to arise; its own nature alone, without reliance on hearing or on the discriminated name, ought to produce recognition of an eye directly. Yet no such recognition, independent of naming, can be found. Therefore, in this matter, it is only with respect to the guest phenomenon that the guest name, notion, and designation "eye" exist at all.
Third, presenting the correct understanding. "Having thus properly reflected on your inner eye, you will likewise come to generate and grasp that the notion of 'eye' itself is only a guest notion."
Second, extending to the rest. As with the eye, so too with the ear, nose, tongue, body, and so forth, extending in full to what is seen, heard, sensed, and cognized, what is already obtained and what is still sought, and whatever attention has been directed, whether coarse or subtle in examination. In brief, throughout every notion of every phenomenon, there is only the arising and grasping of guest notions.

items.title: Section: Properly Embracing the Teaching, Repeated Cultivation, Supreme Equipoise, and Final Liberation

items.zh: 如是汝於自己身中所有假想，能盡除遣勤加行道當正攝受；廣說乃至一切法中所有假想，能盡除遣勤加行道當正攝受。汝由如是一切所知善觀察覺，普於一切諸法想中起唯客想，於一切法所有一切戲論之想數數除遣；以無分別無相之心，唯取義轉，於此事中多修習住。汝若如是，當依如來妙智清淨等持種性，獲得無倒心一境性。如是汝等若於不淨作意思惟，於此作意勿當捨離。若於慈愍，若於緣性緣起，若於界差別，若於阿那波那念，若於初靜慮，廣說乃至若於非想非非想處，無量菩薩靜慮、神通、等持、等至作意思惟，於此作意勿當捨離。汝若如是修此菩薩無倒作意，漸次乃至當得無上正等菩提，究竟出離。當知是名一切菩薩遍趣正行。
items.en:
Second, properly embracing. Just as you diligently apply this path to fully eliminate every guest notion within your own body, so too, extending in full, you should properly embrace this same path to eliminate every guest notion regarding all phenomena.
Third, extensive cultivation. Through this well-examined understanding of all that is knowable, you give rise, throughout every notion of every phenomenon, only to guest notions, repeatedly eliminating every form of conceptual proliferation; with a mind free of discrimination and characteristic, taking only the underlying reality as your object, dwell cultivating this repeatedly.
Fourth, properly settling; first, attaining supreme equipoise. If you practise thus, relying on the Tathāgata's subtle wisdom and pure lineage of equipoise, you will attain an undistorted one-pointedness of mind.
Second, cultivating correct attention. Thus, whether in the attention of contemplating impurity, do not abandon this attention; whether in loving-kindness, dependent origination by conditions, differentiation of the elements, mindfulness of the breath, the first meditative absorption, extending in full to the sphere of neither perception nor non-perception, and every immeasurable bodhisattva absorption, superknowledge, equipoise, and attainment — do not abandon this attention.
Fifth, attaining liberation. If you cultivate this undistorted bodhisattva attention in this way, you will progressively attain unsurpassed, perfect awakening, ultimate liberation.
Third, the overall conclusion. Know this is called every bodhisattva's own universal path of correct practice.

items.title: Section: What the Final Four Powers Accomplish, Closing the Fifth Angle

items.zh: 過去如來亦為始業諸菩薩眾，已正施設如是教授；未來如來亦為始業諸菩薩眾，當正施設如是教授；現在如來亦為始業諸菩薩眾，現正施設如是教授。諸聲聞等於此作意勤修習時，亦能速疾得勝通慧。若能於此無倒作意如實通達，便能獲得諸法現觀。如來所有遍趣行智力，於一切苦能出離行、不出離行如實了知；及令捨離不出離行，能正授與能出離行。如來所有宿住隨念智力，於其前際本事本生數數念已，為令所化諸有情類心生厭離、心生淨信，正為宣說；及能降伏執著常論，一切沙門、婆羅門等。如來所有死生智力，於諸弟子過往遷謝當所受生，能正記莂；及能降伏執著斷論，一切沙門、婆羅門等。如來所有漏盡智力，於自解脫無惑無疑；及能降伏於阿羅漢起增上慢，一切沙門、婆羅門等。是名如來十力作業。
items.en:
Second, universal benefit; first, shared with all buddhas. Past Tathāgatas also established exactly this instruction for beginning bodhisattvas; future Tathāgatas will also establish it; present Tathāgatas are establishing it now.
Second, also benefiting the other vehicles. When śrāvakas and others diligently cultivate this same attention, they too can swiftly attain supreme penetrating wisdom. If they can truly comprehend this undistorted attention, they can attain direct realisation of the true nature of phenomena.
Seventh, the power of wisdom regarding paths to every destination. The Tathāgata's power regarding paths to every destination truly knows, among all suffering, which conduct leads to liberation and which does not; it causes beings to abandon conduct that fails to liberate and rightly bestows conduct that does liberate.
Eighth, the power of wisdom recollecting past abodes. The Tathāgata's power recollecting past abodes, having repeatedly recollected the prior deeds and former lives [of beings], causes the beings to be taught to generate weariness and pure faith, rightly teaching accordingly; and it subdues every rival argument clinging to eternalism among all ascetics and brahmins.
Ninth, the power of wisdom regarding death and rebirth. The Tathāgata's power regarding death and rebirth rightly foretells where his disciples, having passed away, will be reborn; and it subdues every rival argument clinging to nihilism among all ascetics and brahmins.
Tenth, the power of wisdom regarding the exhaustion of outflows. The Tathāgata's power regarding the exhaustion of outflows leaves him without doubt or confusion regarding his own liberation; and it subdues those who, among all ascetics and brahmins, fall into over-estimation regarding arhatship.
Third, concluding. This is called the function of the Tathāgata's ten powers.

blocks.text: The meditation on names continues. The treatise calls both the thing and the name "guests": visitors, not owners of the house.

Venerable Miào Jìng: the guest phenomenon is what is discriminated; the guest notion is what discriminates. Master Cháng Bǎi: the guest notion names, setting a provisional name on the phenomenon. There is "only the name, notion, and designation, and the bare event"; nothing more.
Master Cháng Bǎi: if parents never taught that this is called an eye, one wouldn't take it to be one. Venerable Miào Jìng: without names the discriminating mind cannot arise.

"One gives rise only to guest notions, repeatedly eliminating proliferation." Venerable Miào Jìng: first see that what is discriminated is nothing, then remove false discrimination. The dependent is conventional; suchness alone is ultimate. Master Cháng Bǎi: after the contemplation of impurity is accomplished, let go even of the notion of impurity; attention still tied to names remains proliferation.
Śrāvakas who cultivate this also swiftly gain penetrating wisdom. Master Cháng Bǎi: all buddhas instruct beginning bodhisattvas this way. The eighth power subdues eternalism, the ninth nihilism.
"Guest" is a gentle word. The meditation does not say names are bad, only that they are visitors. We can let them in and let them leave.

quiz.q: In "guest notions upon guest phenomena," what are the two?
options: the guest phenomenon is what is discriminated and named; the guest notion is what discriminates and names
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: the guest phenomenon is what is discriminated; the notion is what discriminates. Master Cháng Bǎi: the guest notion names, setting a provisional name on the phenomenon.

quiz.q: In reflecting on the eye, which two alone can be found?
options: the name, notion, and designation "eye," and the bare event on which they rest
quiz.why: Only the name, notion, and designation, and the bare event. Master Cháng Bǎi: apart from these two, nothing exceeds or adds.

quiz.q: What reason shows that name and thing do not truly match, and what example does Master Cháng Bǎi give?
options: recognition depends on names; never taught "eye," one wouldn't take it for an eye
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: if parents never taught that this is called an eye, one wouldn't take it to be one. Venerable Miào Jìng: without names the discriminating mind cannot arise.

quiz.q: In "extensive cultivation," what is the practitioner to do with notions?
options: regard all as guest notions, repeatedly eliminating proliferation
quiz.why: One gives rise only to guest notions, repeatedly eliminating proliferation. Venerable Miào Jìng: first see that what is discriminated is nothing, then remove false discrimination.

quiz.q: "Taking only the underlying reality." How do the lectures break down 義?
options: two levels: dependent things are conventional, suchness ultimate — Cháng Bǎi: the extent and the nature of things
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: the dependent is conventional, suchness alone ultimate. Master Cháng Bǎi: taking the thing cognizes extent; taking suchness cognizes nature. "Underlying reality" hides the two levels.

quiz.q: "Do not abandon this attention." How does Master Cháng Bǎi relate impurity contemplation and this insight?
options: after impurity succeeds, one must still cultivate this insight; attention not free of names remains proliferation
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: after impurity is accomplished, cultivate this insight to let go of even the notion of impurity; attention still tied to names remains proliferation. Venerable Miào Jìng stresses that this insight must not be dropped.

quiz.q: Whom else does this instruction benefit, and what do they gain?
options: śrāvakas too swiftly gain supreme penetrating wisdom, and direct realisation
quiz.why: Śrāvakas who cultivate this also swiftly gain penetrating wisdom. Master Cháng Bǎi: all buddhas instruct beginning bodhisattvas this way.

quiz.q: What do the eighth and ninth powers subdue respectively?
quiz.why: The eighth subdues eternalism, the ninth nihilism. Master Cháng Bǎi: nihilism holds that nothing remains after death. Venerable Miào Jìng: past events have ceased — impermanent.
